description: Cast a vote for a mayoral candidate in an active neighborhood election. Prerequisite: caller must be a resident of the target neighborhood (fso_roommates on a lot in nhood), must not have moved in <30 days (Election_Move_Penalty; admins bypass), the neighborhood must have an active election_cycle in state='election', and the target must be a running candidate. Effect: fso_election_votes row INSERT (primary key election_cycle_id+from_avatar_id+type='vote' — vote is idempotent per cycle). Returns SUCCESS. Refuse paths: ELECTION_OVER (no active cycle), BAD_STATE (cycle in nomination phase not election), NOT_IN_NHOOD, ALREADY_VOTED, CANDIDATE_NOT_NOMINATED, YOU_MOVED_RECENTLY, CANDIDATE_MOVED_RECENTLY, INVALID_AVATAR. On workshop's current DB state, fso_neighborhoods has no election_cycle_id set, so vote deterministically refuses with ELECTION_OVER — this is the test's expected wire-level effect. Wire: NhoodRequest{Type=VOTE, TargetAvatar, TargetNHood} on city Aries; resolves on the next NhoodResponse.
call_signatures: cf $CF vote --target_persist_id <candidate_persist_id>                                                          # defaults neighborhood_id=1; server refuses ELECTION_OVER on workshop (no active cycle)
common_mistakes: Server returns NHOOD_NO_ELECTION or ELECTION_OVER when no cycle active (workshop default state) → ok:false.
YOU_MOVED_RECENTLY if caller moved in last 30 days (non-admin).
perception_hints: Neighborhood id (defaults to 1 on workshop): perception.lot.lot_id is a lot id, not a nhood id — most ops default nhood_id to 1
Your own persist_id (to avoid self-vote/self-nominate): perception.avatar.persist_id
Your lot membership (residency gate): perception.lot.owner_is_me or check is_roommate via query-lot
refuse_conditions: target_persist_id == own avatar_id → ok:false with 'cannot vote for yourself'
server NHOOD_NO_ELECTION / ELECTION_OVER → ok:false with response code
